latin: Empedocles per spheram intelligibilem a Venere contentam, nihil aliud intelligit quam mundum archetipum ab ordine intra se manentis primae prouidentiae contentum.
translation: By the intelligible sphere held together by Venus, Empedocles means nothing other than the archetypal world, held together by the order of a first providence that remains within itself.
